sourceNotes.found: Two case-study pages tell the same story under different addresses (/case-studies/tourism-new-zealand and /case-studies/tiakicampaign).
sourceNotes.action: Kept one item (tourism-new-zealand) so the story is not counted or cited twice.

sourceNotes.found: The Behavioural & Communications tag page links one case study with a malformed address that repeats its path (veriangroup.com/case-studies/veriangroup.com/case-studies/reducing-water-consumption-england).
sourceNotes.action: Linked the item to its working address.

sourceNotes.found: Fourteen case studies appear only on topic tag pages, not in the main case-study listing as paged through for this import.
sourceNotes.action: Imported them from the tag pages, with the dates shown there.

sourceNotes.found: Paging further through News and insights returns the latest articles again, so older articles are reachable only through topic tags.
sourceNotes.action: Rebuilt the archive from every topic tag page and removed duplicates by address.

sourceNotes.found: Many items carry no topic tag at all, so they never appear when someone browses by topic.
sourceNotes.action: Kept them searchable by text and counted them in the quality report.

sourceNotes.found: "How prepared do we think we are?" is listed under 24 February 2026, but its byline reads 24 February 2025, and it refers to a managing director appointed in January 2026.
sourceNotes.action: Used the listing date, which the content supports.

sourceNotes.found: The child poverty case study names the Ministry of Justice in its page metadata, while its text says the Department for Work and Pensions commissioned the work.
sourceNotes.action: Followed the text of the page.

sourceNotes.found: Two items are published under nested locale paths inside the global section (for example /case-studies/en-gb/case-studies/...), so one page has several addresses.
sourceNotes.action: Kept the address used by the global listing.

sourceNotes.found: Tag pages show a "No Posts Found" message underneath their results.
sourceNotes.action: None needed; noted because it can make a populated topic look empty.
